arxiv-2112-03519.title: Systematic study for the surface properties of neutron star
arxiv-2112-03519.creator: Ankit Kumar 1,2, H. C. Das 1,2, Jeet Amrit Pattnaik 3, S. K. Patra 1,2
arxiv-2112-03519.description: Abstract Background In our earlier work [Phys. Rev. C 104, 055804 (2021)] , we studied the surface properties of a neutron star, assuming it as a huge finite nucleus containing protons, neutrons, electrons, and muons. For the first time, we reported these results of a neutron star for a few representative masses.

arxiv-2207-01952.title: An S ​ U ​ ( 15 ) SU(15) Approach to B B Anomalies
arxiv-2207-01952.creator: Claudio Corianò and Paul H. Frampton
arxiv-2207-01952.description: Abstract The most efficient way to extend the Standard Model of particle theory so that it accommodates the observed B anomalies is the hypothesis of a leptoquark which is a color-triplet weak-singlet boson with electric charge Q = + 2 3 Q=+\frac{2}{3} .

arxiv-2402-13130.title: Are ELECTRA’s Sentence Embeddings Beyond Repair? The Case of Semantic Textual Similarity
arxiv-2402-13130.creator: Ivan Rep, David Dukić, Jan Šnajder
arxiv-2402-13130.description: Abstract While BERT produces high-quality sentence embeddings, its pre-training computational cost is a significant drawback. In contrast, ELECTRA provides a cost-effective pre-training objective and downstream task performance improvements, but worse sentence embeddings. The community tacitly stopped utilizing ELECTRA’s sentence embeddings for semantic textual similarity (STS).

arxiv-2410-09158.title: Unravelling the multiscale surface mechanics of soft solids
arxiv-2410-09158.creator: Nicolas Bain, Lawrence A. Wilen, Dominic Gerber, Mengjie Zu, Carl P. Goodrich, Senthilkumar Duraivel, Kaarthik Varma, Harsha Koganti, Robert W. Style, Eric R. Dufresne
arxiv-2410-09158.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Nicolas Bain, Lawrence A. Wilen, Dominic Gerber, Mengjie Zu, Carl P. Goodrich, Senthilkumar Duraivel, Kaarthik Varma, Harsha Koganti, Robert W. Style, Eric R. Dufresne. The softer a material is, the more its mechanics are sensitive to interfaces. In soft gels, an elastic polymeric network is filled with free-flowing molecules. In theory, either of these components could dominate the material interfacial properties.

arxiv-2506-21066.title: Microphase Separation Controls the Dynamics of Associative Vitrimers
arxiv-2506-21066.creator: Rahul Karmakar, Abhishek S. Chankapure, Srikanth Sastry, Sanat K. Kumar, Tarak K. Patra
arxiv-2506-21066.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Rahul Karmakar, Abhishek S. Chankapure, Srikanth Sastry, Sanat K. Kumar, Tarak K. Patra. Vitrimers are a class of polymers characterized by dynamic covalent networks, where specific monomer units— “stickers" —form reversible crosslinks that enable network rearrangement without loss of overall connectivity. The conventional wisdom is that the sticker dynamics control chain relaxation behavior, and hence the mechanical properties of associative vitrimers where the number of crosslinked sticker pairs is precisely constant over time.

arxiv-2509-10230.title: Signatures of dynamical activity in the hot gas profiles of groups and clusters in the FLAMINGO simulations 2026 Signatures of dynamical activity in the hot gas profiles of groups and clusters in the FLAMINGO simulations – References
arxiv-2509-10230.creator: Lilia Correa Magnus, Scott T. Kay, Joop Schaye, Matthieu Schaller
arxiv-2509-10230.description: Abstract In anticipation of upcoming cosmological surveys, we use the large volume FLAMINGO hydrodynamical simulations to look for signatures of dynamical activity, focusing on the hot gas profiles of groups and clusters out to redshift z = 1 z=1 .

arxiv-2509-13907.title: White Aggregation and Restoration for Few-shot 3D Point Cloud Semantic Segmentation
arxiv-2509-13907.creator: Jiyun Im, SuBeen Lee, Miso Lee, Jae-Pil HeoSungkyunkwan University {bbangsil0110, leesb7426, dlalth557, jaepilheo}@skku.edu
arxiv-2509-13907.description: Abstract Few-Shot 3D Point Cloud Segmentation (FS-PCS) aims to predict per-point labels for an unlabeled point cloud, given only a few labeled examples. To extract discriminative representations from the limited support set, existing methods have constructed prototypes using conventional algorithms such as farthest point sampling.

arxiv-2510-09146.title: Score-Based Density Estimation from Pairwise Comparisons
arxiv-2510-09146.creator: Petrus Mikkola, Luigi Acerbi, Arto Klami
arxiv-2510-09146.description: Abstract We study density estimation from pairwise comparisons, motivated by expert knowledge elicitation and learning from human feedback. We relate the unobserved target density to a tempered winner density (marginal density of preferred choices), learning the winner’s score via score-matching. This allows estimating the target by ‘de-tempering’ the estimated winner density’s score.

arxiv-2601-03893.title: Smooth Sampling-Based Model Predictive Control Using Deterministic Samples This work is part of the German Research Foundation (DFG) AI Research Unit 5339 regarding the combination of physics-based simulation with AI-based methodologies for the fast maturation of manufacturing processes.
arxiv-2601-03893.creator: Markus Walker, Marcel Reith-Braun, Tai Hoang, Gerhard Neumann, Uwe D. Hanebeck
arxiv-2601-03893.description: Abstract Sampling-based MPC ( MPC ) is effective for nonlinear systems but often produces non-smooth control inputs due to random sampling. To address this issue, we extend the MPPI ( MPPI ) framework with deterministic sampling and improvements from CEM ( CEM )– MPC , such as iterative optimization, proposing dsMPPI ( dsMPPI ).

arxiv-2602-11084.title: GRASP: GRoup-shApley feature Selection for Patients
arxiv-2602-11084.creator: Yuheng Luo, Shuyan Li, Zhong Cao
arxiv-2602-11084.description: Abstract Feature selection remains a major challenge in medical prediction, where existing approaches such as LASSO often lack robustness and interpretability. We introduce GRASP, a novel framework that couples Shapley value driven attribution with group L 21 L_{21} regularization to extract compact and non-redundant feature sets.

pmc-11888670.creator: Vaishali S. Pawar, Kailas D. Datkhile, Ajit V. Sontakke, Satyajeet K. Pawar, Prajakta S. Patil

pmc-12399586.title: Effects of all-trans retinoic acid on glutamate receptor expression and dendritic spine density in the hypothalamus of rats
pmc-12399586.creator: Yuan-Zhong Kai, Chun Xia, Qing-Hong Shan, Zheng-Quan Tang
pmc-12399586.description: Increasing evidence suggests that all-trans retinoic acid (ATRA) contributes to the pathogenesis of depression. Although numerous studies have emphasized the role of hippocampal glutamatergic transmission and dendritic spine abnormalities in ATRA-induced depression, it remains unclear whether changes in hypothalamic glutamatergic transmission and dendritic spine density also contribute to its development.

pmc-12844488.title: Fabrication of Microphase-Separated Tröger’s Base Polymer Membranes for Oxygen Enrichment
pmc-12844488.creator: Chaoyue Yang, Li Zhou, Qian Zhang, Ya Huang, Peixiao Zhang, Jingwen Xue, Qing Li, Weijie Sun, Jiayou Liao
pmc-12844488.description: Tröger’s base (TB) polymers have received increasing attention as a novel class of polymers with intrinsic microporosity, particularly for applications in gas separation. In this study, TB was quaternized with hydrophobic long chains to create a microphase-separated structure to enhance gas separation performance. On one hand, the tertiary amine structure of TB enabled facile grafting modification through the Menshutkin reaction.

pmc-13332805.title: Characterization of phylogroups of Klebsiella pneumoniae (K. quasipneumoniae and K. variicola) harbouring blaOXA-232, with special reference to ceftazidime/avibactam/aztreonam synergy and their genetic profile
pmc-13332805.creator: Tuhina Banerjee, Kajal Mishra, Pue Rakshit, Ghanshyam Yadav, Ashok Kumar
pmc-13332805.description: Background Klebsiella pneumoniae is a ‘critical priority’ pathogen responsible for several infections. The emerging evidence of carbapenem resistance in the phylogroups of K. pneumoniae (KpI), namely K. quasipneumoniae (KpII) and K. variicola (KpIII), has drawn attention.ObjectivesGiven the paucity of data, this study was conducted to characterize phylogroups harbouring blaOXA-232 with special reference to ceftazidime/avibactam/aztreonam (CAZ/AVI/ATM) synergy.

pmc-13394140.title: Long‐Term Efficacy of Immunotherapy in Autoimmune Autonomic Ganglionopathy—A 10‐Year Follow Up Study
pmc-13394140.creator: Giacomo Chiaro, Shiwen Koay, Gordon T. Ingle, Patricia McNamara, Laura Watson, Fion Bremner, Valeria Iodice
pmc-13394140.description: ObjectiveAutoimmune autonomic ganglionopathy (AAG) is a rare but potentially treatable cause of severe autonomic failure. Evidence guiding long‐term immunotherapy, treatment sequencing, and residual autonomic impairment is limited. We evaluated long‐term treatment response, residual autonomic dysfunction, and relapse patterns in patients with seropositive AAG.MethodsPatients with seropositive AAG undergoing longitudinal follow‐up with repeated quantitative autonomic assessments before and after immunotherapy were included.
